items.title: IMD issues red alert for Mumbai and coastal Konkan as heavy rains trigger waterlogging in low-lying areas
items.summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) on Sunday issued a red alert for Mumbai, Thane, and Palghar districts following relentless downpours. Several suburban railway tracks near Kurla and Dadar witnessed water accumulation.

items.title: Bengaluru Outer Ring Road and Silk Board junction flooded after intense evening thunderstorm
items.summary: Commuters in Bengaluru faced harrowing traffic jams as heavy convective showers lashed the tech hub on Sunday evening. Bellandur and Marathahalli reported up to 65 mm of localized rainfall in two hours.

items.title: Severe dust storm with 60 kmph winds hits Delhi NCR; flight operations momentarily paused at IGI airport
items.summary: A sudden and violent dust storm swept across New Delhi, Noida, and Gurugram on Sunday afternoon, reducing visibility below 300 meters. Power outages were reported in several residential pockets.

items.title: Heatwave sweeps Vidarbha as Nagpur touches 44.8°C; district administration issues loo warning
items.summary: Nagpur and surrounding districts of eastern Maharashtra recorded peak afternoon temperatures of nearly 45 degrees Celsius. Hospitals have set up dedicated heat stroke wards as dry north-westerly winds continue.

items.title: Heavy rainfall in catchment areas elevates Brahmaputra river level in Guwahati and Kaziranga
items.summary: Continuous monsoon rainfall in the upper ridges of Assam and Arunachal Pradesh has swollen the Brahmaputra river, with water levels approaching danger marks near Guwahati and Dibrugarh.

items.title: Thick winter radiation fog engulfs Amritsar, Ludhiana, and Northern plains; rail schedules impacted
items.summary: Dense fog enveloped Punjab and Haryana early morning, dropping visibility to zero at Amritsar and Chandigarh airports. Over a dozen long-distance express trains are running behind schedule.

items.title: Squally winds and squalls lash Visakhapatnam port; deep depression over Bay of Bengal moves northwest
items.summary: Fishermen along the Andhra Pradesh and Odisha coastline have been advised not to venture into deep sea as gale winds reaching 65 kmph struck Visakhapatnam and Kakinada coast.

items.title: Cloudburst triggers flash flood in Dehradun suburbs; Maldevta river bank submerged
items.summary: Intense torrential rainfall lasting over 90 minutes caused sudden surges in seasonal rivulets near Dehradun and Rishikesh. SDRF teams rushed to evacuate stranded residents from low-lying areas.

items.title: Severe thunderstorms and lightning alert issued for Kolkata, Howrah, and South Bengal districts
items.summary: Nor'wester squalls packing winds up to 70 kmph hit Kolkata and adjacent districts, accompanied by heavy thundershowers and localized hail near Salt Lake and New Town.

items.title: Torrential downpours lash Kochi and central Kerala; water enters homes in Aluva and Kalamassery
items.summary: Heavy overnight rain in Ernakulam district led to severe waterlogging along Kochi city arterial roads. District administration declared holiday for schools across the coastal belt.
